ask: Ask our Threads and X followers which flavour we should bring back: lavender, pistachio or black sesame.

arguments.content: We're bringing one flavour back. You choose:

steps.why: The decision: one post for both, because the question, options and moment are the same; the poll field goes to Threads and X alike. A text post with no media (with media Threads drops the poll). 3 short options fit X's limit of 25 characters each; Bolta refuses a poll X would reject. X's poll runs one day by default. The topic is Threads only.

say: Saved to Acme as one draft for Threads and X: "We're bringing one flavour back. You choose:" with a poll (Lavender, Pistachio, Black sesame), topic Ice Cream on Threads; on X it runs one day. Nothing goes out yet. Schedule it?
never: An image on the poll post: Threads drops the poll.
A poll in a batch item: batch items carry no poll.
An option over 25 characters when X is on the post.
